commandLine:
source $HOME/.bash_profile;
stagingFolderpath=$(echo '/opt/mhi-ac/gateway/dev2/ipv/staging/')
datefolderstaging=$stagingFolderpath/archive/$(date +"%Y%m%d")
[ -d "$stagingFolderpath/archive" ] || mkdir "$stagingFolderpath/archive"
[ -d "$stagingFolderpath/archive/$(date +"%Y%m%d")" ] || mkdir "$stagingFolderpath/archive/$(date +"%Y%m%d")"
find $stagingFolderpath -maxdepth 1 -name "*.*" -exec mv -f {} $datefolderstaging \;
if [ $UseBusinessDate == 0 ]; then
  cd $AC_SYSTEM/apps/mds-ipv
  $AC_SYSTEM/apps/mds-ipv/app-start.sh -e DEV2 -a "-s"
else
  cd $AC_SYSTEM/apps/mds-ipv
  $AC_SYSTEM/apps/mds-ipv/app-start.sh -e DEV2 -a "-s -d $BusinessDate"
fi
